label: pipeline-E2E
scope: Official SDK acquisition -> ParquetDataCatalog -> BacktestNode -> native reports; pipeline E2E only.

source_receipts.relationship: Classifies the original observation; it does not replace or alter the original native results or raw reports.

inputs.price_policy: Four-decimal raw OHLC values preserved exactly; SIM whole-share instruments, not broker instrument qualification.
inputs.timestamp_qualification: The original convention is retained as executed. Its XNYS-close correction belongs to the later Layer 1.5 entrance exam; this derivative does not retime or rerun the original bars.

simulation.fees_and_slippage: Vendor default simulated fills and zero instrument fees; execution realism is unqualified.
simulation.fixed_schedule: Buy 10 whole shares per symbol at bars 1 and 12; close at bars 10 and 16; cleanup at stop.

returned_runs.report_equality_boundary: Native init/event UUIDs and closed-position snapshot UUIDs differ. Original reports remain unchanged; report equality requires normalization of only UUID strings.

pipeline_metrics.interpretation: Native pipeline diagnostics only; ineligible for strategy performance, edge, ranking quality or north-star strategy acceptance.

metric_sources.pnl_and_return: Native BacktestResult.stats_pnls USD PnL (total) and PnL% (total)
metric_sources.trade_count: Native BacktestResult.total_positions, eight closed rows in each positions report and zero open cache positions
metric_sources.max_drawdown: Absent from rc5's default result set; rc5 native MaxDrawdown.calculate_from_returns was applied to each retained native returns_series with equal returned values. No local formula.

layer_1_5.cik_anchored_identity_map: Not performed or accepted for this run
layer_1_5.split_triple_check: Not performed; only the retained official Alpaca corporate-actions response is available
layer_1_5.terminal_price_resolution: Not performed or accepted for this run
layer_1_5.single_provider_corporate_actions: An empty result for the selected symbols and dates, with terminal pagination retained, is a stand-in and does not satisfy the Layer 1.5 gates.
layer_1_5.citation_boundary: No strategy number is qualified while these gates remain unmet.

conditions: Initial runtime API inspection exited 1: BacktestNode uses the 2.x nautilus_trader.backtest export, not the older backtest.node path. No HTTP request or simulation occurred.
Two guessed rc5 documentation paths returned HTTP 404; the upstream source tree supplied docs/getting_started/backtest_high_level.py. These were historical discovery failures.
Acquisition attempt 1 exited 1 before any HTTP call because request metadata's TimeFrame required string serialization; original source was retained and no raw response was overwritten.
Catalog attempt 1 exited 1 because the native ParquetDataCatalog local root did not yet exist; original driver was retained and no bar or instrument had been written.

verification.scope: Read-only verification of retained anchors to publish this derivative; no native acquisition, simulation or unchanged upstream test suite was rerun.

limitations: Layer 1.5 CIK mapping, independent split reconciliation and terminal-price resolution remain unperformed and unaccepted.
Historical bars observed in October 2026 do not reconstruct as-known historical information or a point-in-time universe.
The original provider-midnight-plus-24h timestamp convention remains as executed; XNYS-close correction is a later entrance-exam action.
Default simulated bar fills and zero instrument fees do not demonstrate execution realism or the package's cost assumptions.
No package adapter adoption, LLM-labelled feature, strategy optimization, performance ranking, broker operation or north-star strategy acceptance occurred.
The classification and public receipt reuse the two retained native runs; they are not new model, acquisition or backtest runs.
sanitization: Allowlisted pins, artifact hashes, aggregate native results and qualification limits only. Personal and host paths, account and credential identifiers, private active configuration, conversations, process fields and raw provider/report contents are omitted. Original private receipts and failed-attempt records remain unchanged.
